profile.headline: Senior Software Engineer @ Optos
profile.summary: Full stack software engineer with passion for visualizing data. It's a pleasure to have my code go towards projects that are making someone's day better, whether to be for medical purposes, catering, or any other industry my career leads me to.

positions.title: Full Stack Developer
positions.description:
Full stack software development for client facing medical software.
Front end development using Javascript, Vue.js, and node.js.
Back end API development primarily using C# and .NET Core
Created internal tools for data cleanup and management.
Interfaced with clients regarding project status and requirements for future development.
positions.insights: Skills: JavaScript · C# · Node.js · SQL · Git · Vue.js · ASP.NET · Scrum · Agile Methodologies · Microsoft Azure · Entity Framework · Language Integrated Query (LINQ) · Continuous Integration (CI) · .NET Core · ASP.NET MVC · .NET Framework · npm · Microsoft SQL Server

positions.title: Software Engineer
positions.description:
Developing within an Agile software engineering team for internal and client facing software products and tools.
API development with C# and .NET Core.
Front end web development with Javascript, ASP.NET, and Classic ASP.
positions.insights: Skills: Git · Active Server Pages (ASP) · Scrum · Agile Methodologies · JavaScript · C# · ASP.NET · .NET Core

positions.title: Head Of Knowledge Management
positions.description:
Developed Lost and Found, a tabletop game aiming to teach religious literacy under Prof. Owen Gottlieb.
Tasked with managing and maintaining all documentation for the project.
Represented and demoed the game at BostonFIG 2018.

positions.title: Software Engineer
positions.description:
Developed for the CRDIR Project, a image repair software for fixing errant pixels on images received from a space telescope.
Implemented cleaning algorithms for various image types using MATLAB.
Assisted in UI overhaul.
Managed project timeline and set up source control protocol.

positions.title: Summer Analyst
positions.description:
Cooperated with fellow student analysts and IT team to improve ease of access of database for clients.
Developed GUI for database access for end users utilizing C# and the firm's custom framework.
Assisted with creating database access tool for Python and Java.
